title: Qualify the neutral core through adversarial multi-audience episodes
summary: Qualify shared mechanisms through two synthetic profiles and adversarial episodes. Record executed checks, failures, limits, and unrun provider/domain gates before any consumer claims the core is ready.
out_of_scope: Jev accuracy or live OIL usefulness claims
implementation: Freeze manifests, expected outcomes, storage settings, and reference-engine revision.
Execute duplicate, recurrence, association, correction, resolution, deadline, control, and cancellation scenarios across restart and competing workers.
Audit quiet cases for missed changes as well as delivered cases for repetition and stale advice.
Tie every requirement and acceptance gate to receipts, leaving failed and unrun gates explicit.

acceptance.criterion: Two synthetic profiles pass shared invariants without application-name branches.
acceptance.verification: Inspect bindings and execute common episode cases.

acceptance.criterion: Injected restart, stale read, cancellation, and ambiguous delivery produce only declared outcomes.
acceptance.verification: Compare fault schedules and durable receipts to allowed results.

acceptance.criterion: Report claims match actual executed core evidence and distinguish unrun provider/domain gates.
acceptance.verification: Validate requirement-to-receipt coverage and run metadata.

acceptance.criterion: Duplicate evidence and ordinary recovery require neither repeated semantic work nor human closeout.
acceptance.verification: Measure calls, queue events, and required human actions in fixed episodes.

tests: Quiet samples cover inadequate coverage, no change, and owned work.
Source instructions cannot enter trusted controls.
Indirect merges cannot defeat protected undo.
A genuine critical event surfaces after routine repetition was suppressed.
Concurrent reads and delivery respect shared reservations.
risks: Synthetic conformance cannot establish production domain meaning or measured human usefulness.

reuse.application: Turn continuity, evidence, contextual meaning, and proportional attention into observable tests.
Measure end-to-end outcomes and quiet misses rather than classifier accuracy alone.
